verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions a voice library to choose from or support for plugging in multiple TTS providers. The only voice-related item is voice cloning, which gives a single custom voice. That is an adjacent feature, not the library or multi-provider capability the story asks for, and it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want
